Different procedures and methods shown in the videos are all done under direct supervision of Registered Veterinary Medical Practitioners. We strongly discourage attempting any procedure without proper guidance and supervision of a Registered Veterinary Medical Practitioner.

Care has been taken to present the information and facts in the videos to ensure that the information given is accurate and up-to-date. However, we do not assume any responsibility for any loss or injury or damage to animal or person or property arising out of or related to any use of our videos.
